notes.title: We're participating on Steam's Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello guys! We'll be participating and streaming on the Steam Next Fest! While we'll be streaming for the length of the event we'll answer questions on February 22 at 10AM Pacific Time!

Join us in discussion in our Discord here: https://discord.gg/tmy3hg6Bne

Feel free to check out our demo here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1826820/Johns_Tombstone/

And don't forget to see our trailer!
